dct_description_sm:
Delimitation of territories for which a ministerial order has been published in the Official Gazette of Quebec in order to exempt them from the application of the regulations provided for in the territory of the ZIS. Territories other than those shown may be subtracted later. For more information on the mapping of flood zones in Quebec, consult the information available on the Ministry's website using the following link: 

http://www.cehq.gouv.qc.ca/zones-inond/zone-intervention-speciale.htm**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
